name: updateInterfaceStationAssignment
description: Updates which station this interface is assigned to. Corresponds to PUT /api/stations/v1/interfaces/{interfaceId}/station-assignment. Requires `stations:write` scope. [WRITE]

interfaceId.description: The unique identifier for an interface.

replaceInterfaceAtStation.description: Replace the interface already at that station, if any. Without it, assigning to an occupied station fails with 409.

stationId.description: The ID of the station to assign the interface to
